parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export file format: xlsx (default) or csv

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which records to export: all (ignores filters, keeps status tab) | filtered (default, honors active filters/search) | current_page (just the page the user is viewing) | selected (requires ids param)

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated InventoryAllocation IDs. Required when scope=selected.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated column keys to include (preserves request order). Allowed: id, status, priority, sku, product_name, sales_order_number, backordered_quantity, released_quantity, supplier, covered_by_po, eta, other_warehouse_stock, in_transit_stock, backorder_date, order_date, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at. Omit to export all columns.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search across id, sku, product name, supplier name, sales order number, PO number

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Status tab. Preserved even when scope=all. Values: active | pending | released | partial | cancelled

parameters.name: filter[covered_by_po]
parameters.description: true | false — filter by whether the backorder is covered by a PO

parameters.name: filter_groups
parameters.description: Grouped advanced filter tree (JSON-encoded). Same structure used by List Backorders.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Same options as List Backorders. Ignored when scope=all.
